page.notes: Top line: "cidus" is at the start of the first line and may be a fragment; the reading is uncertain, hence [?]. "comebant" is read as printed and is doubtful. The italic "pavore" is followed by a printed dash-like mark, rendered as a full stop. A small printed ornament stands between the italic passage and "1 D. Petrus"; it is not text. A tiny mark "1" stands below the catchword at bottom centre; it is not transcribed as a signature because it is not clearly a gathering signature. Long s is plain s throughout; the hyphen in "fecun-dum", "il-la", "fer-vi" is a line-end hyphen and is kept in the words as printed.
